title: The public Calendar tab shows the guest calendar to everyone, with one link to the team calendar

source.ref: Plans and calendar clarity audit 2026-11-25 (project thread: Audit the project and calendar system; doc https://claude.ai/artifact/GUTHmChGkqaEmPSRUdzJHz)

detail: FOUND 2026-11-25: a Space's team sees two different team calendars. The public tab (/spaces/<slug>/calendar) renders CalendarWorkspace with the older StaffCalendar (Workflow and List), and the console renders CalendarSuite. They share data but not behaviour, so a team member learns two tools. Fix: the tab is the guest calendar for everyone plus an 'Open team calendar' button to the console; StaffCalendar leaves the tab. Reverses the 2026-10-29 ruling that kept team tools on the tab. Owner call pending on a decision card in the audit thread (2026-11-25); park this row if Daniel picks the other option.

verify.note: Fails today; passes once the consequence in the title holds.
